title: Breaking the Silence: A Dataset and Benchmark for Bangla Text-to-Gloss Translation
abstract: arXiv:2504.02293v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gloss is a written approximation that bridges Sign Language (SL) and its corresponding spoken language. Despite a deaf and hard-of-hearing population of at least 3 million in Bangladesh, Bangla Sign Language (BdSL) remains largely understudied, with very limited prior work on Bangla text-to-gloss translation and no publicly available parallel dataset at the time of this work. To address this gap, we construct the first publicly available Bangla text-to-gloss dataset, consisting of 1,000 manually annotated and 4,000 synthetically generated Bangla sentence-gloss pairs, along with 159 expert human-annotated pairs used as a test set. Our experimental framework performs a comparative analysis between several fine-tuned open-source models and a leading closed-source LLM to evaluate their performance in low-resource BdSL translation. translated_title: 打破沉默：面向孟加拉语文本到手语词汇翻译的数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 手语词汇标注是一种书面近似形式，用于连接手语（SL）与其对应的口语。尽管孟加拉国至少有300万聋人及听力障碍人口，但孟加拉手语（BdSL）在很大程度上仍未得到充分研究，此前针对孟加拉语文本到手语词汇翻译的研究工作非常有限，且在本研究开展之时尚无任何公开可用的平行数据集。为填补这一空白，我们构建了首个公开可用的孟加拉语文本到手语词汇数据集，其中包含1,000个人工标注和4,000个合成生成的孟加拉语句子-手语词汇对，另有159个由专家人工标注的句子-手语词汇对作为测试集。我们的实验框架对多个经过微调的开源模型与一个领先的闭源大语言模型进行了对比分析，以评估它们在低资源孟加拉手语翻译任务中的表现。GPT-5.4取得了最佳的自动评估指标分数，而开源模型的表现也具有竞争力，尽管（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文构建了首个公开可用的孟加拉语文本到手语词汇翻译平行数据集及基准测试，填补了孟加拉手语研究的资源空白，并通过对比开源模型与闭源大语言模型评估了低资源场景下的翻译性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first publicly available Bangla text-to-gloss parallel dataset and benchmark for Bangla Sign Language translation, and evaluates fine-tuned open-source models against a leading closed-source LLM in this low-resource setting.
